parsed.review_summary: The candidate edit corrects all three error targets identified in the original rationale. It fixes the evidence misread by acknowledging that the comment does specify the experiments (feature representations and prediction probabilities), the phenomenon to demonstrate (mitigating shallow semantic similarity), and the explicit anchor to Figures 3 and 4 with reference [1]. It corrects the factual error and unsupported inference by removing the claim that authors lack precise guidance. It addresses the rubric misapplication by describing the rubric-relevant qualities—explicit actions combined with concrete implementation details—without stating a numeric score or gold label. Unrelated correct reasoning from the original rationale (the identification of the two deficiencies as explicit actions) is preserved. The corrected rationale is coherent, faithful to the evaluated answer, and free of direct score or label statements.
